PowerShell($o = npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1; "errores:"; \($o | Select-String "lectura-prensado|interfaces.ts|Prensado"\); npx eslint src/app/dashboard/lectura-prensado 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 30)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://apps.chaide.com/proord/api/api/servicios/buscarSecuencialPrensado" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "$\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { $sr = New-Object IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); $sr.ReadToEnd\(\) } })

PowerShell(foreach \($est in @\("Puesto 1","Puente1","Impresion"\)\) { "=== estacion: $est"; try { $body = @{ orden = "62815177"; estacion = $est } | ConvertTo-Json; $j = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://apps.chaide.com/proord/api/api/servicios/buscarEtiquetasXOrdenPrensado" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "filas: $\($j.data.Count\)  codbarras distintos: $\(\($j.data | Select-Object -ExpandProperty codbarras -Unique\).Count\)"; $j.data | Select-Object codbarras, operador, netiqueta, secuencial, fecha | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200 } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell($out = npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | Out-String; \($out -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match "lectura-prensado|planchaEspumaPrensado" }\) -join "`n"; "--- errores totales: " + \([regex]::Matches\($out, "error TS"\)\).Count)
